name: forge-desktop
description: Forge as a desktop app: Forge's webview and host in a Tauri window, with no editor.

scripts.prepare:app: node scripts/build-forge.mjs && node scripts/build-host.mjs && node scripts/stage.mjs
scripts.dev: node scripts/build-host.mjs && node scripts/stage.mjs && tauri dev
scripts.test: node scripts/build-host.mjs && node --test "test/*.test.mjs" && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
